runbook: R-18 / R-19 (independent oracle; evidence tree = `git archive HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md` only)

evidence_tree.command: git archive --format=tar HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md | tar -x -C <scratch>

sources_quoted.text: After using an ability, your next basic attack within 10 seconds deals {{as|100% '''base''' AD}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} [[on-hit]]. If the target is a champion, inflict them with ''Expose Weakness'' for 4 seconds, causing them to take {{rd|8%|5%}} increased damage from all sources ({{fd|1.5}} second cooldown, starts after using the empowered attack).

Dealing {{as|physical damage}} to an enemy champion applies a stack of ''Carve'' for 6 seconds, stacking up to 5 times. Each stack inflicts {{as|6% armor reduction}}, up to {{as|30%|armor}} at 5 stacks.

sources_quoted.source: data/items.json (cache-wide) — calibration of the wiki `{{rd|melee|ranged}}` template: first argument = melee holder, second = ranged holder
sources_quoted.text: Tiamat/Ravenous Hydra Cleave `{{rd|40% AD|20% AD}}`; Titanic Hydra Cleave `{{rd|1%|{{fd|0.5}}%}}` max health; Blade of the Ruined King Mist's Edge `{{rd|9%|6%}}` current health; Death's Dance Ignore Pain `{{rd|30%|10%}}` — in every case the known in-game melee value is the FIRST argument.
m(R) = 100 / (100 + R) (apply_resistance, resistance.py) ... EHP round-trip raw = post*(1+R/100)
Black Cleaver average stacks (`ArmorReductionEffect.average_reduction`) ... the exact Cesaro mean of the capped ramp min(k, C) over h hits is C - C(C-1)/(2h) for h >= C

step_1_observed_ratio.rounding_band: with both leaves rounded to 0.1, the true ratio lies in [157.75/98.65, 157.85/98.55] = [1.5991, 1.6017]

step_2_what_can_and_cannot_produce_that_.black_cleaver_carve: 5 stacks x 6% = 30% armor reduction. Under m(R)=100/(100+R) the damage ratio of shredded vs unshredded is (100+R)/(100+0.7R), which is monotone in R and bounded above by 1/0.7 = 1.4286 (armor -> inf). At realistic armor (60/100/200) it is 1.127 / 1.176 / 1.250. Percentage reduction cannot push armor below 0 (math-foundations §2.3 item 3), so no larger factor exists. CANNOT produce 1.60.
step_2_what_can_and_cannot_produce_that_.bloodsong_spellblade_row: 100% base AD bonus physical on-hit — an additive row, not a 1.60x multiplier of an existing row unless base AD were exactly 0.6004 x the auto's damage base (an unconstrained coincidence).
step_2_what_can_and_cannot_produce_that_.expose_weakness_rate_substitution: 8% / 5% = 1.6000 EXACTLY. This is the only wiki-sourced constant pair in the whole item cache with ratio 1.60 (enumerated every `{{rd|a|b}}` numeric pair in data/items.json: 0.504, 0.714, 1.091, 1.100, 1.250, 1.286, 1.300, 1.333, 1.400, 1.429, 1.500, **1.600 = Bloodsong Expose Weakness only**, 1.667, 2.000, 3.000). MATCHES.

step_3_shared_base_check.premise: If the leaf is the Expose Weakness amplification applied to the coupled partner's ('pair') damage, leaf = rate x D for one unchanged base D.
step_3_shared_base_check.rounding_intervals: D in [1971.0, 1973.0] from the 5% reading and D in [1971.875, 1973.125] from the 8% reading; overlap [1971.875, 1973.0] is non-empty
step_3_shared_base_check.conclusion: Both leaves are consistent with ONE unchanged underlying damage base D ~ 1972 and a pure rate substitution 5% -> 8%. Nothing else in the fight changed at this leaf.

step_4_which_rate_the_wiki_mandates.rule: `{{rd|melee|ranged}}` selects on the ITEM HOLDER's attack type (melee = first argument, calibrated above against Tiamat/Titanic/BotRK/Death's Dance, whose melee values are known). Expose Weakness is a debuff on the target that amplifies damage 'from all sources'; the game has no mechanism for its magnitude to vary with WHO deals the damage — the split is a property of the Bloodsong holder alone.
step_4_which_rate_the_wiki_mandates.scenario_inference: The scenario build is Black Cleaver + Bloodsong. Black Cleaver (40 AD / 400 HP / 20 AH, Carve requiring repeated physical damage application) plus a Spellblade support item scaling on 100% BASE AD is a melee AD-support archetype (Pyke / Pantheon / Rell class). Ranged supports do not build Black Cleaver. Holder = melee => Expose Weakness = 8%.
step_4_which_rate_the_wiki_mandates.failure_mode_the_old_value_matches: 98.6 = 5% x D is exactly the RANGED branch. In a coupled/'pair' computation this is the classic mis-attribution: evaluating the melee/ranged split against the damage SOURCE (a ranged partner in the roster) or taking index 1 of the parsed [melee, ranged] pair, instead of against the Bloodsong holder. The cached rune data shows this parse shape is fragile in this codebase (`effects.melee_ranged_ratios: [0.08, 0.05]` on Conqueror; Fleet Footwork carries `parse_warnings: melee_ranged_ratios matched more than once`).

step_5_result.formula: pair_damage = Expose_Weakness_rate(holder=melee) x D = 0.08 x 1972.4 = 157.8 (0.05 x 1972.4 = 98.6 is the ranged branch)
step_5_result.note: The engine's mitigation identity (math-foundations §2.1) is untouched by this leaf: the amplification multiplies an already-computed damage base, and both candidate values share that base to within rounding.

confidence_and_caveat.confidence: high on the mechanism (8%/5% Expose Weakness rate substitution — exact ratio, unique in cache, shared base confirmed)
confidence_and_caveat.caveat: The scenario roster (which champion holds Bloodsong) is defined in scripts/, which this runbook forbids reading. The verdict rests on the wiki rule that the melee/ranged split is a property of the item HOLDER, plus the melee-only archetype implied by a Black Cleaver + Bloodsong build. If — and only if — the Bloodsong holder in `cleaver_bloodsong_roster` is a RANGED champion, the correct leaf is 98.6 and the verdict would flip to old_value_correct. No other reading of the two items' cached text produces either number.
